name: Dispensary Districts 8 Apr 1956
description: The 587 dispensary districts of Ireland at the census of 8 Apr 1956, mapped from the District Electoral Divisions the census report lists for each (CSO Census of Population 1956, Vol. 1, Table 10, which gives each district's DEDs by their 1911 reference numbers, read against the DEDs and acreages of Table 11). The DED map is Phelim Birch's and Paddy Matthews's District Electoral Divisions in force on census day (Connacht 1919, Leinster 1954, Munster 1955, Ulster 1921). Every district carries a grade (confidence) and the reason for it (confidence_reason): A where the printed area equals the sum of its DEDs' areas in Table 11, so the composition is the census's own; B where the composition checks only as part of a group or needed a small adjustment; C where it could not be checked, for the reason given. 550 are graded A; 12 B, where Table 10 prints one bracketed area for a group (Cobh Nos. 1-2, Middleton Nos. 1-2, Rathkeale Nos. 1-2, Sligo Nos. 1-3, Enniscorthy North and South) or none (Annacotty, Clarina and Limerick Rural), and the group's DEDs add up to it exactly; and 25 C: the Dublin county districts and Waterford Rural Nos. 1-2, printed as registrars' districts partly in the county borough with no area, and districts in Kildare, Waterford and Galway that divide DEDs (each divided DED placed with the district holding its larger part, or by the best fit to the printed areas). Two pairs of Dublin districts with no whole DED of their own are shown together (Crumlin / Terenure; Finglas and Glasnevin Nos. 1 and 2), and Coolock and Drumcondra No. 2 is not a separate feature. The city dispensary districts of Dublin, Cork, Limerick and Waterford are not mapped: the census builds them from parts of DEDs and wards, so each county borough is shown as one unit, without a population. A district that crosses a county boundary is shown as one part per county, as the table prints it. Each district carries its census area, population, Table 10 reference numbers and DEDs; quote census_acres rather than the map area, which takes in lakes and estuaries the census leaves out. Population is printed for 581 of the 587.
